subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should backup exclude support land in core now, and if so must `.backupignore` be explicit opt-in with per-asset filtering before merge?
rationale: The PR changes recovery- and security-sensitive backup scope plus public CLI semantics, and automation cannot choose the product policy for implicit exclude files or warning-only external asset bypasses.

options.title: Require explicit per-asset semantics
options.body: Make `.backupignore` opt-in, apply excludes to every backup asset root, preserve current-main backup hardening, and require real create/verify proof before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Split a smaller current-main PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch and ask for a narrow current-main implementation that only adds the agreed CLI/API surface and focused tests.

options.title: Accept warning-only bypass
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the current warning-only external asset behavior, but that owns the risk that excludes do not actually filter some backup assets.

recommendation.title: Require explicit per-asset semantics
recommendation.body: Make `.backupignore` opt-in, apply excludes to every backup asset root, preserve current-main backup hardening, and require real create/verify proof before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest current-main backup implementation owner from PR #101974 and the latest line history.
